name: Yule Quan Yiyun - S Hao Fang Shijian
source: In her attempt to solve the mystery of her parents’ death, Chen Ruoxia is accidently drawn into the storm of unspoken rules in the entertainment industry. Hiding behind it is a truth even uglier... In this showbiz world surrounded by dark secrets and conspiracies, will she be able to escape with the truth or will she become their next victim?
translation: 为了查明父母死亡的真相，陈若霞意外卷入娱乐圈的潜规则风暴。隐藏其后的真相更加丑陋……在这个充斥着黑暗秘密与阴谋的演艺圈里，她能否带着真相全身而退，还是会成为下一个受害者？
